newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy BCI to buy majority in Banco Orinoco.
newsitem.headline: Italy BCI to buy majority in Banco Orinoco.

text.p: Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI) said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with some shareholders in Venezuela's Banco del Orinoco to buy a majority stake in the Venezuelan bank.
BCI said in a statement the acquisition, made through its Banque Sudameris subsidiary, was subject to approval by the Bank of Italy.

The accord envisaged on the one hand that BCI would purchase existing shares for part of the stake and on the other subscribe to a capital increase "for a significant amount which will bring in fresh funds", the statement said.
